page.layout: One printed page with two columns of running text; no margin notes, no footnotes. Running head at the top centre. Page number at the top, left of the head. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Jam forsan me refpicient nonnulli ut meorum Confiliorum Authorem, & cùm alium non habeant in quem litem intendant, in me posthac omne odium effundent, quamquam id semper illis ægrè fuerit, ut vel ullâ animi mei libertate gauderé, vel confcientiæ meæ luci obtè- perarem, quem fibi planè addici & mancipari volunt, fua inprimis confilia à Me probari debere exiftimantes qui tam diù contra me Bellum gefferunt.

Satis quidem fuiffet illius diei victoria, cùm accefferunt in prædam Litera mex, ad explendam illam Famæ popularis ambitiofiffimam fitim: fiquidem apud vulgus hominum benè tantum audiunt profpera,contra adverfa & afflicta conditio omni ftatim contumeliâ excipitur, quasi Bona Fortuna Umbra semper effet virtutis, & non frequentius turpia & injufta facinora in hoc Mundo profequeretur.

Verùm illis qualicunque fucceffu nunquam fatis muniri videtur & commendari caufa ejufmodi, quæ à Turbis aufpicata de Aura Populari dependet. Has ergo fuis confiliis utiliffimas ducunt victorias quæ famam & exftimationem meam apud populum peffundent. In horum

page.notes: Several words are uncertain in the scan: "Confu!-" and "Ambitiofiffimam" are read as printed; the line "Verùm illis qualicunque fucceffu" is the printed "fucceffu nun-" with the catchword "horum" at the foot. "Umbra" is read as printed (Umbra fem-per); "Litera" is printed with a small-capital hint and may be a misreading of "Literæ". Where a word is broken across lines the hyphen is kept as printed. The left edge of the scan is dark and some letters near the gutter are hard to read; the transcription of the first column's final lines and the second column's middle is the least certain. Text is set in roman with italic words as printed.
